Supreme Court Stays Life Sentences for Two Bilkis Bano Case Convicts

The Supreme Court has stayed the life sentences of two convicts in the Bilkis Bano case. Bilkis Bano stated that the Supreme Court halted the convicts' sentences without hearing her, and she is "scared again." The court's decision involved specific details on what was said in the ruling.
